events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, an 'Aquarian Exposition: 3 Days of Peace & Music', took place in Bethel, New York, from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace and music. What was your favourite Woodstock moment?

events.title: Elvis Presley Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at his Graceland estate in Memphis, Tennessee, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 today. His music still moves generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the American-British lead singer and primary songwriter of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice with The Pretenders is as distinctive and powerful as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher, known for his distinctive vocal style and outspoken personality, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', which debuted on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to 007 and over six decades of iconic espionage. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, musician, and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His vision of peace and incredible music continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python and co-creator of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite sketch or character?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
